Earlier scenes:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。他的妈妈觉得在墓地玩儿，害得，所以他们搬家。搬家对孟子有好的影响，他才五岁，可是每天不是写字就是帮妈妈的工作。

This scene:
他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人：很聪明

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他很聪明的人：他是一个很聪明的人，The noun phrase needs the copula 是 to serve as the predicate; 一个 also makes the reference to one person natural. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 成为：成为了，This describes a completed outcome in the narrative, so add 了 after the verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 难怪他成为了有名的人：难怪成为了有名的人，Use zero form for the same subject in the second part of the same sentence; the reader can still understand that the subject is 孟子. [rule: none]

items.reason: “他很聪明的人” lacks a valid predicate structure, and adding 是一个 makes it grammatical.
The becoming-famous event is a completed narrative outcome, so 成为了 is appropriate.
Repeating 他 in the second clause is natural and clear, so zero reference is optional rather than required.
